notes: 0.3.31：问题反馈改走 GitHub。之前是"写进配置仓库 feedback\ 再 push"，配置仓库的远端其实是 Gitee，反馈去不了 GitHub，而且要看历史还得先把仓库拉下来。现在反馈以 GitHub Issue 为唯一真源：面板提交 → 直接 POST /repos/QcWyGm/dsh-config-sync/issues（label=feedback，正文末尾自动附插件版本、机器名、时间、平台、安装目录与配置仓库路径），列表直接读 Issue（open/closed 都在，点标题就跳浏览器），点「已解决」就是 PATCH 成 closed，GitHub 上还是同一个线程、能继续讨论。令牌不用手填：默认从本机 git 凭据（git credential fill）取一次并存进 <dshHome>\config-sync-gh.json（本机私有、不进仓库，面板里能看到路径），取不到才需要粘贴一次，粘完会立刻用 /repos/{repo} 验证一遍。断网或令牌失效时提交不算失败：先进 <dshHome>\config-sync-feedback-outbox.json 本机队列，面板显示"还有 N 条没发出去"，联网后点「补发」逐条建 Issue。仓库地址与 label 可改（面板「换令牌」里连仓库一起填）。
notesEn: 0.3.31: feedback moved to GitHub. It used to write into the config repo feedback\ folder and push, but that repo points at Gitee - the reports never reached GitHub, and reading history meant pulling the repo first. Now GitHub Issues are the single source of truth: submitting in the panel POSTs /repos/QcWyGm/dsh-config-sync/issues (label=feedback, with plugin version, machine, time, platform, install root and config repo path appended to the body); the list reads Issues directly (open and closed), the title opens the browser, and Resolve PATCHes the Issue to closed - same thread on GitHub, still discussable. No token typing needed: by default it is taken once from the local git credential (git credential fill) and stored in <dshHome>\config-sync-gh.json (local only, never committed, path shown in the panel); only if that fails do you paste one, which is verified immediately against /repos/{repo}. Offline or with an expired token, a submission is not lost: it goes into the local <dshHome>\config-sync-feedback-outbox.json queue, the panel says how many are pending, and Flush creates the Issues one by one when the network is back. Repo and label are configurable (fill both in the Change token row).
